items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: A contribution-style heatmap of daily activity over 26 weeks, with a diagonal reveal, weekday and month labels, hover/focus tooltips, and a Less-to-More legend.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Revenue over time with a self-drawing line, morphing ranges, and a pointer crosshair.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A grouped monthly bar chart (this year vs last year) with toggleable legend series, a hovered-month tooltip, and a lens glint on the active bar.

items.name: conversion-funnel
items.title: Conversion funnel
items.description: Visitors to paid with narrowing bars that fill in cascade, step-to-step drop-off percentages, and a slow flow shimmer on hover.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A sortable transactions table with animated row reordering, live search, and compact pagination.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Revenue by plan donut whose segments draw around the ring, with a count-up centre and a lens glint at the start angle.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature bento
items.description: A five-tile bento grid of product features, each with a small live illustration: a self-drawing sparkline, a ticking counter, a toggling switch, a progress ring, and a typing command line. Tiles lift and glow on hover.

items.name: goal-progress
items.title: Goal progress
items.description: Quarter goals with linear progress bars that fill in sequence, milestone ticks, and a count-up percentage. A goal hitting 100% earns a quiet check mark and a soft ring pulse.

items.name: kpi-counter
items.title: KPI counter
items.description: A row of KPI cards whose numbers spring into view, with delta badges and self-drawing sparklines.

items.name: live-feed
items.title: Live feed
items.description: A live activity feed where events slide in at the top, with relative timestamps, a pulsing live indicator, and pause on hover.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing toggle
items.description: Three pricing plans with a monthly/yearly switch: prices morph digit by digit, the yearly saving badge slides in, and the recommended plan carries a slow border light.

items.name: radial-gauge
items.title: Radial gauge
items.description: A 240° radial gauge with a self-drawing arc, a sweeping needle whose tip is a lens glint dot, tick marks around the dial, a count-up score, and a label with a delta beneath.

items.name: stat-ticker
items.title: Stat ticker
items.description: A horizontally scrolling ticker of live stats (MRR, signups, conversion, NPS) that loops seamlessly, fades at both edges, pauses on hover/focus, and flips each value with a vertical slide as it refreshes.

items.name: stats-section
items.title: Stats Section
items.description: A quiet marketing stats band with four large numbers that count up when scrolled into view. Each stat pairs a small trend with a thin animated underline, with dividers on desktop and a 2x2 grid on phones.

items.name: testimonial-marquee
items.title: Testimonial Marquee
items.description: Two rows of testimonial cards drift in opposite directions with soft edge fades, pausing on hover or focus. Star ratings, initials avatars and a calm static grid for reduced motion keep it readable.

items.name: uptime-status
items.title: Uptime status
items.description: A status page with three services, each shown as 90 daily bars that rise in with a wave, hover/focus tooltips with date and status, an overall uptime count-up, and a legend.
